summary: Open an external-protocol URL using the OS default handler.

target.notes: Uses native OS integration without requiring Chromium.

caveats: Treat untrusted URL inputs as a security-sensitive sink; preserve Electron's platform limits/options.
Windows documents a URL length limit.

tests.name: open https URL
tests.expected_behavior: requests opening in the OS default handler and fulfills on success

tests.name: handler failure
tests.expected_behavior: Promise rejects/fails according to OS/Electron behavior rather than silently succeeding
